title: Boundary-adjacent Read File Record
purpose: Drive grouped file-record parsing with one valid subrequest and corrected MBAP length.
expected_behavior: Server should parse a valid Read File Record request with one 7-byte subrequest group and either return record data or an exception if unsupported.
constraints_preserved: length is 0009 for unit_id plus 8-byte PDU
byte count 07 matches exactly one 7-byte file-record subrequest
subrequest starts with reference type 06 followed by file number, record number, and record length
issue_safety_notes: Valid grouped structure only; avoids malformed length combinations.
